record.field: <form string="Triage Session"> <header> <button name="complete" string="Complete"/> <!-- Review is reviewer-only (T016/T045) --> <button name="review" string="Review" groups="gnuhealth_afya_core.group_clinical_reviewer"/> <button name="create_evaluation" string="Create Evaluation" groups="gnuhealth_afya_core.group_clinical_reviewer"/> <field name="state" widget="statusbar" status="draft,completed,reviewed,escalated,cancelled"/> </header> <notebook> <page string="Intake" id="intake"> <group col="4"> <label name="session_id"/> <field name="session_id"/> <label name="session_start_time"/> <field name="session_start_time"/> <label name="access_session"/> <field name="access_session"/> <label name="consent"/> <field name="consent"/> </group> <label name="symptoms_raw"/> <field name="symptoms_raw"/> <label name="symptoms_raw_expires_at"/> <field name="symptoms_raw_expires_at"/> </page> <page string="Assessment" id="assessment"> <group col="4"> <label name="triage_level"/> <field name="triage_level"/> <label name="triage_confidence"/> <field name="triage_confidence"/> <label name="human_review_required"/> <field name="human_review_required"/> <label name="posthoc_consent_needed"/> <field name="posthoc_consent_needed"/> </group> <label name="clinical_rationale"/> <field name="clinical_rationale"/> </page> <page string="Review" id="review"> <group col="4"> <label name="reviewer_decision"/> <field name="reviewer_decision"/> <label name="review_timestamp"/> <field name="review_timestamp"/> </group> <label name="reviewer_notes"/> <field name="reviewer_notes"/> </page> </notebook> </form>
